# nflverse samples

**Real data, trimmed.** Recorded on 2026-10-23 with `scripts/record_nflverse_fixtures.py`:
Arizona and Houston only (Marvin Harrison Jr. moved ARI -> HOU in 2026), skill positions, 2026
weeks 1-6, plus 2024 weeks 1-2 for the older injury and depth-chart formats. Schedules are the
full 2024 and 2026 seasons; rankings are 2026 weekly positional ECR for these players.

NFL data from [nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse), licensed CC-BY 4.0 (FTN charting data
CC-BY-SA 4.0). Rankings are FantasyPros expert consensus rankings as published by nflverse.

Rerun the script to refresh them.
